def solve(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    total_amount = df.group_by("group").agg(pl.col("amount").sum()).select("group", pl.col("amount").alias("total"))
    result = df.join(
        total_amount,
        on="group",
        how="left"
    )
    result = result.with_columns(
        (pl.col("amount") / pl.col("total")).alias("pct_of_group")
    )
    return result
```

def solve(sales: pl.LazyFrame, regions: pl.LazyFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    joined = sales.join(regions, on="store", how="left")
    result = (
        joined.group_by("region")
        .agg(pl.col("amount").sum())
        .sort("region")
        .collect()
    )
    return result
```

    return (
        lf
        .group_by("customer")
        .agg(pl.col("amount").sum().alias("amount"))
        .filter(pl.col("amount") > 100)
        .sort("amount", descending=True)
        .collect()

def solve(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return (
        df
        .pivot(
            on="region",
            index=None,
            values=["q1", "q2"],
            aggregate_function="first",
            maintain_order=False,
            separator="_",
            column_naming="auto",
        )
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("q1").alias("value"),
            pl.col("q2").alias("value"),
        )
        .explode(pl.col("value"))
        .sort(["region", "quarter"])
    )
```

def solve(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return (
        df
        .select(
            pl.col("id"),
            pl.concat_str([pl.col("a").alias("a"), pl.col("b").alias("b"), pl.col("c").alias("c")]).alias("name"),
            pl.col("a").alias("value"),
            pl.col("b").alias("value"),
            pl.col("c").alias("value"),

        .unnest("name")
        .unnest("value")
        .filter(pl.col("value") > 5)
        .sort(["id", "name"])
    )

output:

def solve(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return (
        df
        .group_by(["region", "segment"])
        .agg(
            pl.col("units").sum().alias("units")
        )
        .pivot(
            on="product",
            values="units",
            index=["region", "segment"],
            aggregate_function="sum",
            maintain_order=True,
            sort_columns=True,
        )
        .sort(["region", "segment"])
    )
```
